aliases: Pere Marquette Township data center candidate

status_detail: Historical 2013 candidate proposal; no evidence found that the Mason County candidate was built. In 2026 Pere Marquette Charter Township began a proposed one-year data-center moratorium, but no named current project was verified.
notes: 2013 local report says the proposed Mason County site was north of the Ludington pumped storage facility between Chauvez and Bradshaw roads, east of South Lakeshore Drive, with Consumers Energy likely to move its data-center facilities from Jackson if the state center was built. Current official township notice records only a data-center moratorium process, not a named current application.

status_detail: Village meeting to discuss proposal was postponed on Aug. 10, 2026 due to crowd/OMA access concerns; project details remain unclear.
notes: Big Rapids Pioneer reports GenH literature describes a hydro adaptive aqua system near the Morley/Frank Deyo Dam and calls the proposed development a data service facility. Officials understood it as a roughly 20-by-30-foot prefabricated building using siphoned water to generate hydroelectric power; exact data-service use and power use were not yet clear. Big Rapids Township separately adopted a preemptive data-center moratorium in February 2026.
